system.description:
Repeated exposure has taught you that supernatural repetitions have rules, even when those rules are unpleasant.
When you successfully use Interpret Haunt, you gain a +2-circumstance bonus to the next saving throw or skill check you make against that haunt within the next hour.
On a Critical result, you may also grant this bonus to one ally who hears your explanation.

Prerequisites Occultism 3 ranks

Use after a successful Interpret Haunt: queues +2 circumstance for your next save or check against that haunt (target an ally first to give it to them on a Critical).
